LightningComponentBundle.description: Kanban-style board of Work Item records, with configurable columns.

property.name: projectId
property.label: Project Id
property.description: Show only this project's work items. Leave blank for every work item the running user can see.

property.name: columns
property.label: Board columns
property.description: Ordered, comma separated Status__c values. Adding a status here is all that is needed to add a column.
